name: scrcpy
role: Mirrors and records an Android device or emulator screen to MP4 over adb
notes: 2026-11-27: Triage: assess; fills the Android device-capture gap beside baguette (iOS Simulator only). Lead said Homebrew 5.0.1; confirmed by `scrcpy --version` on this Mac.

2026-11-27: Evidence partial: a 3 s headless H.264 MP4 of a connected Android TV device (Android 11, 1920x1080) matched `adb shell wm size`; but `--no-window --no-playback` segfaulted on startup in several runs, so the fixture retries up to 3 times.

evidence.result: Recorded 3 s of a connected Android TV device (Android 11) with --no-window --no-playback --no-audio: H.264 MP4 1920x1080 equal to adb wm size, duration 2.91 s, two frames non-blank and different. scrcpy segfaulted at startup in about a third of runs; run.sh retried (up to 3) and passed. ffprobe 9.0.2, macOS 26.6 arm64.
evidence.scope: One Android TV over adb TCP, 3 s H.264 MP4; startup segfault in ~1 of 3 runs (retried); no phone, emulator, audio, camera, USB, pixel hashes or isolated keypress effect

summary: Genymobile's open-source CLI that mirrors and controls an Android device or emulator over adb and records its screen to MP4, MKV or audio files. With --no-window --no-playback --record it runs headless; --time-limit bounds the take. Capture is real-time, so frames are not seekable or deterministic.
use_when: Capture an Android app or device screen as a source clip for an app preview
Record an Android take headlessly with a time limit while adb sends scripted input
Mirror an Android emulator or device with audio recorded to a file
avoid_when: Capturing an iOS Simulator: use baguette
Frames must be seekable or deterministic: capture is real-time, so use a browser or native render route
Adding a device bezel to a capture: record first, then use frames-cli

assessment.rationale: Official README documents headless recording (--no-window --no-playback --record) and --time-limit; Apache-2.0; Homebrew 5.0.1 recorded a real device here. No other catalogued tool captures an Android screen. Release date not independently checked.
